skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    weights = inputs["bag_weights"]
    personal_used = False
    carry_on_used = False
    checked_position = 0
    total = inputs["ticket_price"]
    for i in range(len(weights)):
        fits_personal = lengths[i] <= premises["personal_item_limits"][0] and widths[i] <= premises["personal_item_limits"][1] and heights[i] <= premises["personal_item_limits"][2]
        fits_carry_on = lengths[i] <= premises["carry_on_limits"][0] and widths[i] <= premises["carry_on_limits"][1] and heights[i] <= premises["carry_on_limits"][2]
        cabin_item = False
        if fits_personal and not personal_used:
            personal_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        elif fits_carry_on and not carry_on_used:
            carry_on_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        if not cabin_item:
            checked_position = checked_position + 1
            base_index = min(checked_position - 1, len(premises["checked_base_fees"]) - 1)
            base_fee = premises["checked_base_fees"][base_index]
            outside_dimensions = lengths[i] + widths[i] + heights[i]
            size_fee = 0
            for j in range(len(premises["size_fee_lower_bounds"])):
                if outside_dimensions > premises["size_fee_lower_bounds"][j] and outside_dimensions <= premises["size_fee_upper_bounds"][j]:
                    size_fee = max(size_fee, premises["size_fees"][j])
            weight_fee = 0
            for j in range(len(premises["weight_fee_lower_bounds"])):
                if weights[i] > premises["weight_fee_lower_bounds"][j] and weights[i] <= premises["weight_fee_upper_bounds"][j]:
                    weight_fee = max(weight_fee, premises["weight_fees"][j])
            total = total + base_fee + max(size_fee, weight_fee)
    return {"answer": int(total)}
